parsed.explanation: Combined federal-state regime imposes tier-1 universal exposure: birth-sex passport/facility rules, entry refusal for document discrepancy with possible permanent fraud ineligibility, federal bar on gender-congruent government facilities, and a state bathroom ban expanded in 2026 with a documented trespass arrest and 24-hour men's-ward hold. Custody treatment/hormone-removal and reported immigration-custody abuse add severity if detained. No execution, routine imprisonment, or organised sweeps are documented, and courts have enjoined some orders, granted litigation relief, and preserved employment/marriage protections, so remedies partially work. This sits between 0.35 routine exclusion without remedy and 0.55 document friction/delay. Minors face added school-bathroom, sports and care restrictions.

entry_documents.exposure: Passport X/mismatched markers no longer issued; Nov 2025 Supreme Court allowed restriction. Cable: discrepancy/doubt on sex -> refuse and seek evidence; suspected wilful misrepresentation -> consider permanent lifetime fraud ineligibility. Trans travellers report confiscation/blocking.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid until expiry; fraud finding requires four elements, never automatic, limited waivers; ACLU suit pending and foreign advisories issued.
entry_documents.interaction: Home-passport mismatch triggers federal entry screening, then possible fraud investigation/detention, bypassing protective state policies.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: From 2026 national corrections adopted freeze-frame model: hair cutting, hormone removal, psychiatric substitution; immigration custody reports of forced labour, beatings, solitary and severe sexual abuse for trans men. No division case on cell placement documented.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Courts have enjoined some executive orders; no documented remedy shown for freeze-frame or immigration-custody abuse in dossier.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Entry/facility arrest can lead to birth-sex custody and treatment denial, compounding entry exposure.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Federal order bars trans people from government-funded single-sex facilities congruent with identity. Division: May 2026 law and budget rules require public school/college/university restrooms by birth sex; 2025 capitol arrest for women's restroom, handcuffed, held 24h in men's ward, trespass up to 60 days.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Trespass requires wilful entry plus refusal to depart; exemptions listed. National appellate order allows one student plaintiff boys' bathroom during litigation; law unenforceable against him.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Federal facility bar applies regardless of state protections; state ban adds criminal exposure in schools/universities and some government buildings.

care_services.exposure: Executive order labels minor gender-affirming care mutilation; proposed rules would bar public insurance under 18; DOJ subpoenaed hospitals for minors' records. Custody hormone removal documented. Visitor adult routine care not documented as barred.
care_services.protection: Several orders blocked/enjoined; no documented operative visitor care protection or denial in dossier.
care_services.interaction: Care seeker, especially minor, can face investigation, funding and record exposure interacting with document/facility rules.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Federal framing as binary sex, removal of gender-ideology materials, trans-athlete entry ban, counterterrorism strategy prioritising radically pro-transgender groups, cash-reward memo using radical gender ideology. Poll: 66% support birth-sex documents.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Bostock employment protection and national hate-crime statute remain; marriage recognition nationwide; several orders enjoined.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Official threat-framing increases discretionary enforcement at borders, facilities and schools despite court constraints.

minors_guardians.exposure: Division school/higher-ed bathroom by birth sex; 2022 sports ban; national order directs criminal prosecution of teachers facilitating social transition/name/pronouns; 27 states ban minor care. Travelling minor faces facility, school and care exposure; guardian may face investigation/funding consequences.
minors_guardians.protection: Court order allows one student bathroom use during equal-protection litigation; other orders enjoined. No documented visitor-specific minor protection.
minors_guardians.interaction: Minor status converts bathroom/sports/care issues into school, custody and parental-investigation exposure.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No documented pattern of trans-specific killings, sweeps or police extortion in dossier. Documented harms are institutional: capitol arrest, custody abuse reports. Division has no hate-crime statute (2007 source), unrepealed sodomy provision, DV statutes only opposite-sex couples.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime statute covers gender identity; only 23 states include it in state bias statutes. Police/court remedy for street violence not documented.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Absence of state hate-crime recourse weakens response, but no organised targeting documented to elevate beyond institutional exposure.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Passport suit and executive-order challenges unresolved; SCOTUS allowed passport restriction. Enforcement varies by state, officer and facility; hormone/custody and entry outcomes uncertain for visitors.
remedies_unknowns.protection: ACLU litigation, injunctions, appellate bathroom relief, legal-aid FAQ, written entry decisions/appeal in principle. Remedies slow and not shown to reverse entry refusal or custody treatment before departure.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Working courts mitigate some orders but do not cancel operative federal entry/facility rules or state criminal trespass exposure.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar universal border exclusion for presentation/document mismatch and weak practical remedy at entry, with humiliation and refusal. Lower than 0.35-A overall because US courts enjoin some orders and imprisonment/execution are not routine, but entry fraud-ineligibility threat is comparable severity.

Similar document discrepancy causing secondary screening, delay and possible refusal. This case is lower than 0.55-B because federal facility bar is categorical, state bathroom use carries documented arrest, and custody hormone removal is documented, not merely administrative friction.

Higher than 0.75-C: there, mismatched passports cause brief detention with counsel, reasons and compensation. Here mismatch can cause entry refusal, permanent-ineligibility consideration, facility arrest and men's-ward hold with no documented compensation remedy.

parsed.synthesis: Operative interaction is entry discrepancy -> refusal/fraud consideration -> possible detention with birth-sex placement and hormone-removal treatment; separately, federal and state facility bans expose the traveller in every government building, with one documented arrest. Court injunctions, hate-crime and employment law, and a bathroom litigation carve-out show partial, domain-specific recourse, but do not pre-empt the documented border/facility/custody exposures. No lethal campaign is documented, placing the case below 0.25 anchors yet arrival in Elevated Risk due to tier-1 universal exposure.
